I'm **Annamalai Vikash Raam Manoj**, currently studying Business Analytics at Monash University after completing a Computer Science degree specialising in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

What interests me about analytics is the process of moving from a question to an evidence-based answer. I enjoy exploring how data can reveal patterns, how visualisations can make those patterns easier to understand, and how technical methods can help solve practical problems.

My interests span data analysis, visualisation, databases, and applied AI. Through coursework and independent projects, I'm developing a broader perspective on not just how analytical solutions work, but also how their results can be communicated and used.

Outside individual projects, this website is a space for experimentation and learning. I'll use it to document selected work, share analytical stories, and reflect on what I discover along the way.
